page_title: Blog to Video: Turn Your Posts Into Videos · videos.social

sources.entry: videos.social - Turns blogs, PDFs, and prompts into editable faceless videos. 1 free render. Packs from $10. 1 credit = 1 render. #freemium

summary.name: videos.social
summary.one_liner: A web tool that turns a pasted blog post link (or a PDF or typed topic) into a narrated, faceless video in 16:9 or 9:16 format, with one-line edits that don't regenerate the whole video.
use_cases: Repurposing a blog post as a YouTube video
Making vertical clips for Shorts, Reels or TikTok from written articles
Turning a PDF or research paper into a narrated explainer
Fixing a single line in a video without regenerating it
Producing batch videos for a content team
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes a link to a blog post, reads it, and generates a short script, scenes and a voiceover, producing a narrated video in minutes. Users choose wide 16:9 or vertical 9:16 output and a target length. Individual lines, scene timing, voice, colours, music and visuals can be changed without regenerating the rest of the video. Videos are narration over motion graphics with no presenter or avatar. Users can also save brand fonts, colours and logo, and export an MP4.
notable: Single-part editing: change one line, scene, or voice without remaking the whole video
Accepts blog links, PDFs, YouTube videos, or typed topics as input
Works with AI agents using the same account and credits
Drafting and editing are free; credits are spent only on export
caveats: First export is free; further exports require credit packs starting at $10 for 10 exports
Credits are one-time purchases that do not reset and there is no monthly plan
Videos are narration over motion graphics only; no faces or avatars
